assumptions.claim: params.endTime > block.timestamp and uint256(params.endTime) - block.timestamp <= RaffleConstants.MAX_SALE_DURATION
params.prizeToken has deployed code, reports IERC721 support via ERC-165, and is not factory, quoteToken, vrfWrapper, raffleImplementation, or a registered raffle in isRaffle
params.raffleId is a unique 1-based identifier matching RaffleFactory's registry entry for the clone
Every registered raffle clone has destination.code.length != 0 so _isProtocolDestination does not skip canonicalFactory.isRaffle(destination) for registered clones
assumptions.establishedBy: Clones.clone deploying 45-byte ERC-1167 runtime bytecode at packages/contracts/src/RaffleFactory.sol:L106 (packages/contracts/node_modules/@openzeppelin/contracts/proxy/Clones.sol:L54-L57) with no SELFDESTRUCT in Raffle.sol

assumptions.claim: params.sponsorRecipient and params.protocolTreasury are not precomputed future CREATE addresses of RaffleFactory (which have code.length == 0 and isRaffle == false during initialize at L602-L603, but later become registered clones with isRaffle == true when _transferQuote re-evaluates _isProtocolDestination at L565)

calls.propagates: Returns true iff destination equals address(this), factory, address(quoteToken), address(i_vrfV2PlusWrapper), prizeToken_ (params.prizeToken), canonicalFactory.raffleImplementation() (L599-L601), or has destination.code.length != 0 and canonicalFactory.isRaffle(destination) == true (L602-L604). Because isRaffle[address(this)] is not set until RaffleFactory.sol:L125 (after initialize), rejection of the current clone during initialize relies on the destination == address(this) branch at L599. Addresses with code.length == 0 at initialization time bypass the isRaffle query at L602.

Called via STATICCALL inside _isProtocolDestination (Raffle.sol:L601) when destination does not match the first five addresses; returns the immutable implementation address set in RaffleFactory.constructor (RaffleFactory.sol:L89-L91) without reverting.

Called via STATICCALL inside _isProtocolDestination (Raffle.sol:L603) only when !unsafeDestination && destination.code.length != 0; returns true iff destination was already registered by RaffleFactory.createRaffle (RaffleFactory.sol:L125) prior to this call.

invariants.claim: initialize can succeed at most once per clone and only when called by the immutable factory; it can never succeed on the implementation contract itself.
After initialize succeeds, sponsor, sponsorRecipient, protocolTreasury, and address(prizeToken) are non-zero and immutable for the lifetime of the clone.

After initialize succeeds, prizeTokenId, raffleId, reserveEntries, and endTime equal the supplied calldata fields and remain unchanged for the lifetime of the clone, and status equals Status.AwaitingPrize.
